name: en_to_chinese_words
description: Few-shot English->Chinese single-word translation. Control: same format, English->English copy.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
D=[("dog","狗"),("cat","猫"),("house","房子"),("water","水"),("bread","面包"),("book","书"),("tree","树"),("sun","太阳"),("moon","月亮"),("city","城市"),("car","汽车"),("friend","朋友"),("night","晚上"),("red","红色"),("green","绿色"),("black","黑色"),("white","白色"),("woman","女人"),("man","男人"),("child","孩子"),("king","国王"),("time","时间"),("world","世界"),("school","学校"),("door","门"),("window","窗户"),("table","桌子"),("chair","椅子"),("milk","牛奶"),("apple","苹果"),("fish","鱼"),("bird","鸟"),("horse","马"),("sea","海"),("mountain","山"),("river","河"),("fire","火"),("hand","手"),("head","头"),("heart","心"),("eye","眼睛"),("money","钱"),("work","工作"),("love","爱"),("street","街道"),("week","星期"),("year","年"),("morning","早上"),("summer","夏天"),("winter","冬天"),("cheese","奶酪"),("wine","葡萄酒"),("garden","花园"),("kitchen","厨房"),("flower","花"),("rain","雨"),("snow","雪"),("wind","风"),("egg","鸡蛋"),("key","钥匙"),("blue","蓝色"),("happy","快乐"),("brother","兄弟"),("teacher","老师"),("doctor","医生"),("computer","电脑"),("phone","电话"),("tea","茶"),("rice","米饭"),("country","国家")]
items=[];control=[]
for t in D:
    shots=random.sample([d for d in D if d is not t],3)
    items.append({"prompt":"".join(f"English: {s[0]}\nChinese: {s[1]}\n\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {t[0]}\nChinese:","answer":" "+t[1]})
    control.append({"prompt":"".join(f"English: {s[0]}\nEnglish: {s[0]}\n\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {t[0]}\nEnglish:","answer":" "+t[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open("/work/skill.json","w"),ensure_ascii=False)
